text: Production review of Supported beginner balance.
This draft has not been professionally approved and is not for exercise use.
The proposed session begins with a stable chair or wall, a clear space, and a comfortable pace.
The reviewer must confirm the movements, alternatives and timing before filming.
With stable support nearby, step to the side slowly and bring the other foot alongside.
Change direction after a few comfortable steps.
Keep the hips level.
A rest window follows.
The final narrator will invite the viewer to settle, take a comfortable breath, or pause for longer.
There is no target to chase.
Face a wall with fingers resting against it.
Keep the standing knee soft while lifting the other foot briefly.
Put it down before changing sides.
A rest window follows.
The final narrator will invite the viewer to settle, take a comfortable breath, or pause for longer.
There is no target to chase.
Beside a wall, place one heel just ahead of the other foot’s toes.
Look forwards and take a few controlled steps, using the wall if needed.
A rest window follows.
